label: Evidence-based
_basis: The Salafi / ahl al-hadith position on awqāt al-nahy, issued as ONE ruling for everyone rather than by school. Anchored to IslamQA (Ibn Bāz, Ibn ʿUthaymīn) and al-Albānī. Coincides with the Shāfiʿī outcome except that the funeral prayer in the three solar windows is discouraged-unless-needed (al-Albānī, Aḥkām al-Janāʾiz) rather than freely permitted. See research/salafi-awqat-al-nahy.md. This is the shipped DEFAULT so the user need not pick a madhhab.
sources: IslamQA 81978 (causal-prayer exception is the more correct view)
IslamQA 20013 (qaḍāʾ of fard obligatory even in prohibited times)
IslamQA 136695 (W1 tied to the Fajr prayer, not the raw time)
al-Albānī, Aḥkām al-Janāʾiz (janāzah in the 3 solar times: avoid unless necessity)

P_sunrise.basis: Until the sun has risen a spear's length (~15-20 min); scholar to set final value.

P_zenith.basis: Istiwāʾ until zawāl; a few minutes; scholar to set final value.

P_isfirar.basis: From the sun yellowing until it fully sets; scholar to confirm.

anchor_convention.basis: The after-Fajr/after-Asr bar attaches to having PRAYED (IslamQA-preferred); the app cannot know that, so it anchors conservatively to the prayer-time entry. Scholar to confirm.

fardCurrent.basis: A due obligatory prayer is never barred by the prohibited times.

qada.basis: "Let him pray it when he remembers" (Bukhārī/Muslim); a make-up is a prayer with a cause.

janazah.basis: The funeral prayer has a present cause; the burial prohibition names only the three solar times.

causalNafl.basis: Dhawāt al-asbāb (taḥiyyat al-masjid, wuḍūʾ, ṭawāf, kusūf...) are permitted; Ibn Taymiyyah, adopted by IslamQA.

pureNafl.basis: "No prayer after Fajr until the sun rises" (Bukhārī/Muslim) - only causeless nafl is blocked.

fardCurrent.basis: Fajr's time ends at sunrise; make it up as qaḍāʾ once the sun has risen. Never a bare NO (spec §3.6).

qada.basis: Making up a missed obligatory prayer is obligatory even here (IslamQA 20013).

janazah.basis: al-Albānī: avoid in the three solar times except in case of necessity; the Uqbah hadith names burial here.

causalNafl.basis: Ibn Bāz / Ibn ʿUthaymīn extend the causal-prayer exception even into the strict solar windows.

pureNafl.basis: Causeless nafl is prohibited in the strict times.

fardCurrent.basis: No obligatory prayer's window naturally falls at istiwāʾ; defined defensively as PERMITTED.

qada.basis: Making up a missed obligatory prayer is obligatory even here.

janazah.basis: al-Albānī: avoid in the three solar times except in case of necessity.

causalNafl.basis: Causal prayers are permitted; the Friday-zenith greeting is the clearest case.

pureNafl.basis: Causeless nafl is prohibited in the strict times.

fardCurrent.basis: A due obligatory prayer is never barred by the prohibited times.

qada.basis: Umm Salamah: the Prophet made up the Dhuhr sunnah after Asr - a causal make-up is allowed here.

janazah.basis: The burial prohibition names only the three solar times; after Asr it is permitted.

causalNafl.basis: Dhawāt al-asbāb permitted; the after-Asr bar is on causeless nafl only.

pureNafl.basis: "No prayer after Asr until the sun sets" (Bukhārī/Muslim) - causeless nafl only.

fardCurrent.basis: That day's unperformed Asr must still be prayed before Maghrib; valid, though delaying it was sinful.

qada.basis: Making up a missed obligatory prayer is obligatory even here.

janazah.basis: al-Albānī: avoid in the three solar times except in case of necessity.

causalNafl.basis: Ibn Bāz permitted causal prayers even as the sun sets.

pureNafl.basis: Causeless nafl is prohibited in the strict times.
